tutorial.info: The round, trick and team scores are shown here. Opposite seats are fixed partners in 2v2, and you are seat 0. There is no bidding.
tutorial.trick: Cards played to the table appear here. You must follow the led suit, and must play a trump when void. The Matto alone is exempt and may be played at any time -- though it never takes a trick.
tutorial.hand: Your hand: 15 of the 62 tarot cards. The four marked **Papa** rank equal to each other and are drawn in a different colour from ordinary trumps.
tutorial.actions: The heart of this game is that **the four papi rank equal and the later-played one wins**. If you carry over the usual "only a strictly stronger card takes the trick" instinct, you will expect the first papa to win. Note they are a middle group: a higher ordinary trump still beats them. As dealer you also bury 2 surplus cards, and buried cards score for your team.
